## 🎯 Purpose

In dbt, Bronze is typically the 'Staging' layer.
It reads from a 'source' (Raw) and does light casting/renaming.
Since we don't have the raw DDL, we assume a source exists.

---

## 📐 Code Pattern (Extracted from v3.9)

```python
-- BRONZE LAYER (Staging)
-- Generated by Legacy2Lake Architect Agent
-- Source: {...}

with source as (
    select * from {{ source('legacy_source', '{...}') }}
),

renamed as (
    select
        *,
        current_timestamp() as _ingested_at
    from source
)

select * from renamed
```
